findings.title: Reputation / Research Lore page citation disagrees with the Core index (p.200 vs p.201)
findings.where: Decision 2 verified-source-quotes + per-endeavour table; Finding-7 response parenthetical
findings.problem: Design cites Reputation and Research Lore as Core p.200, but the Core index lists both at p.201. Both are guidance-only and the RAW text quoted is correct, so no mechanic is affected; this is a citation-accuracy slip.
findings.fix: Change the two citations to Core p.201 for Reputation and Research Lore, and correct the Finding-7 parenthetical accordingly.

findings.title: T2 low-coin trigger ignores brass (wD) while the rationale prints it
findings.where: Decision 2 triggers T2; OQ-4 resolution (wGC === 0 && wSS === 0)
findings.problem: A character holding only brass still fires the low-coin nudge while the rationale shows a non-trivial brass figure, which can read as self-contradictory. The threshold is a defensible, explicitly-flagged OQ-4 decision.
findings.fix: Add a rationale clause when wD > 0 (brass not counted toward spendable status coin) or a code comment noting wD is intentionally excluded from the trigger.

findings.title: FR-2.3 Unusual Learning is satisfied only via rationale prose
findings.problem: Unusual Learning is mentioned only inside the Training rationale string, not as a distinct recommendation. This is a legitimate reading of 'where relevant' (GM-set test -> guidance-only) but could surprise a reader expecting a separate affordance.
findings.fix: State explicitly in T3 that Unusual Learning is a rationale mention only (not a separate Suggestion) and why (GM-set test, OQ-6).

findings.title: resolveSeededTarget snippet omits note that referenced imports already exist
findings.where: Calculated-total tooltips section, reminders-target.ts code block
findings.problem: The snippet uses CharacteristicKey/Character/ReminderTest/computeSkillTarget/computeCharacteristicTarget. All are already imported in the current reminders-target.ts (verified), so the refactor compiles, but the snippet reads as if some types might be newly needed.
findings.fix: Add a one-line note that all referenced types/helpers are already imported in the current reminders-target.ts; the refactor adds no new imports.
